defs.def: a mark or an object formed by two lines crossing each other (X or +); the mark (X) is often used on paper to show sth 叉字形记号；十字形记号

ex.s: He rushed out of Mrs Hill’s house and crossed the street quickly.
ex.t: B 她是一名健身教练。

ex.s: An idea suddenly crossed Cruse's mind.
On the 1,100 kilometer journey, the man Cao Shengkang, ___62___ lost his eyesight at the age of eight in a car accident, crossed 40 cities and counties in three province.
ex.t: 在1100公里的旅程中，曹盛康先生___62___八岁时因车祸失明，穿越三省的40个市县。

ex.s: To me, there's nothing better than a cross-cultural afternoon tea of English biscuits and a cup of Chinese oolong tea in a fine china cup!
ex.t: 对我来说，没有什么比在精致的瓷杯中享受一场跨文化的下午茶——英式饼干配一杯中国乌龙茶——更美好了！

ex.s: My family and I have managed to cross the North American continent, from western to eastern Canada, in two weeks!
ex.t: 我和家人已经成功穿越了北美大陆，从加拿大西部到东部，只用了两周时间！

ex.s: We got lost a few times even with the help of GPS, but eventually we managed to cross the Rocky Mountains.
ex.t: 即使在GPS的帮助下我们也迷路了几次，但最终我们还是成功穿越了落基山脉。

ex.s: Each day began with a 5-kilometer cross-country run - at 6 am!
ex.t: 每天以五公里越野跑开始——早上六点！

defs.def: a long vertical piece of wood with a shorter piece across it near the top. In the past people were hung on crosses and left to die as a punishment. （旧时用以处死人的）十字架

ex.s: Never stick them upright in your food or cross them as you use them
ex.t: 绝不要把筷子竖插在食物里或交叉使用

ex.s: When you were trying to figure out what to buy for the environmentalist on your holiday list, fur probably didn’t cross your mind.
ex.t: 当你在为假期名单上的环保主义者挑选礼物时，毛皮可能根本不会出现在你的脑海中。

ex.s: One chilly night when I was hiking in the Rocky Mountains with some students, I mentioned that we were going to cross a mountain stream.
ex.t: 当水没过膝盖时他们才发现这是一个温泉。

ex.s: All you have to do is cross out the wrong words.” But he is equally well known for his witty remarks in his everyday interactions with people.
ex.t: 你只需要划掉错误的词。"但他同样以其在日常交往中机智幽默的言辞而闻名。

defs.def: the cross that Jesus Christ died on, used as a symbol of Christianity （耶稣钉死在上面的）十字架
an object, a design, a piece of jewellery, etc. in the shape of a cross, used as a symbol of Christianity 十字架物品（或设计、首饰等）
a small decoration in the shape of a cross that is given to sb as an honour for doing sth very brave （表彰英勇行为的）十字勋章
a mixture of two different things, breeds of animal, etc. 混合物；（动物等的）杂种，杂交品种
a kick or hit of the ball across the field rather than up or down it 足球或曲棍球
to go across; to pass or stretch from one side to the other 穿越；越过；横过；渡过
to pass across each other 交叉；相交
to put or place sth across or over sth else 使交叉；使交叠
to oppose sb or speak against them or their plans or wishes 反对，反驳，否定（某人或计划、意愿）
to make two different types of animal breed together; to mix two types of plant to form a new one 使杂交；使异种交配
to kick or pass a ball sideways across the field 足球或曲棍球
to draw a line across sth 画横线于
to make the sign of the cross (= the Christian symbol) on your chest （在胸口上）画十字圣号
